name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup as cards or a tree and a map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp), MCP servers and skills. Connect them by drawing a line, with preview and Undo; the map lights up while an agent works, an ⓘ legend explains every mark, and Hide puts away what you don't use. A Healthy & Security check explains and sets what each agent may do unasked; Help shows disk space. Hugging Face models, local LLM installs. 8 languages.
